name: ImpGuard
description: a stocky hell imp of the Magma King's guard: dark red leathery skin, short curled horns poking through a dented helmet of black cooled slag with a glowing orange crack across it, a breastplate of slag plates, folded bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, stern yellow eyes, three glowing orange embers held fanned out between the claws of one hand, no sack

poses.stand: hovering in mid-air on spread bat wings, chest out, standing guard, the three embers held ready
poses.struck: just hit: helmet knocked crooked, eyes bulging, mouth open in a shriek, wings snapped up, the embers flying from its hand, cracks of orange light glowing through its skin
poses.dead: bursting apart in a small round pop of black soot and bright orange embers, only its slag helmet and two curled horns tumbling out of the puff

idle.action: hovers in place, flapping its wings steadily, tail swishing, watching straight ahead

attack.action: draws its arm back and flings the three embers forward to the right in a fan, then hovers again

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with its helmet rattling, then squares up again

die.action: shrieks, swells up with orange light shining through the cracks, and pops like a firecracker into soot and embers, its helmet and horns dropping out of the smoke
